accepted_artifacts.note: State cache reports the registered source-gap closure and cumulative record counts; live Issues/PRs remain execution truth.

conflicts_and_limitations: The source-gap supplement closes 20 registered gaps with new rules and confirms one was already covered by P02-200.
The 77 supplemental records include 13 CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY records; these are not reusable projection rules.
The source-gap summary explicitly limits its claim to the registered gap IDs and does not claim complete extraction of every possible claim on printed pages 5–9.
The P01 state cache points to further source-first review of historical candidates; this milestone does not complete the entire P01 corpus.
The validation results are reported in the merged PR; no validation workflow was run by this Sidecar task.
wording_ceiling: The accepted Knowledge supplement closes 21 registered P01 source gaps on printed pp5–9 and adds 77 source-bounded records, while preserving source time scope and the distinction between reusable rules and case-only support.
forbidden_inferences: Closing 21 registered gaps means all possible source claims on printed pp5–9 have been extracted.
All 77 supplemental records are reusable rules.
Case-support-only records are executable canonical rules.
The supplement introduced a new shared semantic primitive or time scale.
Source-gap closure establishes real-world predictive validity.
